subject: Procurement & pricing — next steps (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
messages:

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & pricing — next steps

Thanks again for the time today, Alex — good alignment from our side. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs.

Call recap:
- Use case: inference for customer-facing search + embeddings at scale (latency sensitive).
- Preferred models: 70/30 mix of curated open models and Redwood-verified variants.
- Key constraints: SLA for 99.9% availability, SOC 2 evidence, and procurement prefers PO-based billing.

Commercial options (high level):
1) Hosted (Redwood API) — on-demand per-token billing; fast to get started; supports card or invoice for larger customers; minimal integration effort.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — committed monthly/annual GPU pools; best unit economics and predictable throughput; supports PO/invoice; SLA-backed.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — for regulated workloads; platform fee + optional support; typically procurement + legal-led purchase.

Questions for procurement to confirm path:
- Will Acme require a PO for initial procurement or are credit card/invoice options acceptable?
- Is marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace) preferred or required? If yes, we can provide listing/pricing guidance.
- Target procurement timeline (legal + finance signoff window).

Action items:
- I attached an updated pricing sheet and SOW draft for the Dedicated/Hosted paths. Please share Samantha's procurement contact and preferred billing path.
- If helpful, I can schedule a short procurement call with our finance/legal lead next week.

Best,

Appreciate the clarity, Alex — helpful. Quick answers and next steps below.

Marketplace & billing:
- Redwood supports marketplace billing for Hosted (API) via AWS Marketplace today; Dedicated can be procured via marketplace in certain arrangements but typically goes through an invoice/PO because of reserved capacity and sizing needs. If marketplace is a hard requirement, we can engage our partnerships team to scope a listing for Dedicated — timeline ~2-3 weeks for commercial paperwork.

Commitment tiers (example):
- On-demand (Hosted): pay-as-you-go; baseline price.
- Committed Monthly (Dedicated): 3-month, 12-month, 36-month commits; discounts scale with term and GPU count (example: ~15% for 12-month, ~25% for 36-month vs on-demand at typical usage patterns). Exact numbers depend on GPU type and model mix — attached pricing sheet has sample tiers.

PO vs card:
- PO/invoice is accepted for Dedicated and Private purchases and for Hosted for customers with invoicing on file (we can set that up once procurement is engaged). For pilots we suggest card-based on Hosted to reduce friction.

Compliance docs:
- Attached SOC 2 summary. If legal/procurement needs a full security questionnaire, send Samantha our vendor security contact and we'll route the questionnaire to our security team.

Next steps:
1) Samantha, can you confirm the PO routing address and any vendor packet fields we should populate?
2) If marketplace is preferred, confirm and we'll escalate to partnerships to scope Dedicated listing or provide Hosted marketplace options.
3) Marissa/Aditya can join a short procurement sync next week (30 min) to walk through SOW and billing model — when works for you?

Thanks — attaching the pricing and SOW again for easy reference.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_v3.pdf, Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf
